slug: 2024-11-13 Teraco to build 40 MW JB7 data centre at Isando Campus

facts.fact: Teraco, a data centre company, secured a new R8 billion syndicated loan through Absa and other financial institutions to fund its 40 MW JB7 data centre at Isando and other construction, announced 2024-11-13 (the document gives no signing date).
